study: S1g (M2-10, docs/processing/m210d_event_selection_diagnosis.md section 7): two same-depth PEC pipes, lateral separation 0.6 m and 1.0 m, plus a single-pipe control
author: electromagnetic-simulation-expert, 2026-11-11

conventions.coordinates: gprMax x horizontal, y up. Ground surface y_surface_m; depth d = y_surface_m - y
conventions.trace_x_m: x_m[i] = scan_start_m + i * trace_step_m (Tx/Rx midpoint), i = 0..n_traces-1
conventions.antenna: z-directed Hertzian dipole Tx at x_m - 0.05, Rx (Ez) at x_m + 0.05, both at y_antenna_m (common offset 0.10 m, same as M01-M20)
conventions.wavelet: gprMax ricker 500 MHz (current of the dipole), peak at sqrt(2)/f = 2.8284 ns
conventions.air_gap: h = 0.10 m (air-coupled, 4TU-like single direct+surface band; same h as M12/M13)
conventions.array_layout: rxs/rx1/Ez merged (Iterations, ntraces) float32, raw field, no gain/filter/time-zero shift
conventions.depth_reference: pipe_top_depth_m is the pipe crown below the ground surface
conventions.export_axes: same as the M01-M20 export json: trace_x_m_first 0.40 (Tx/Rx midpoint), dx_m 0.02, time_of_sample0_ns 0.0, dt_ns = gprMax dt (raw simulation time)

g4_background_line.decision: use G4: export S1G_BGL (161-trace background line) as line S1G/S1G_BGL
g4_background_line.why_not_3_traces: S1G_bg has 3 traces 1.6 m apart; the generator, apex hint (+-3 traces), NMS 0.3 m and support logic need a 0.02 m line. Tiling one trace into 161 would make any lateral background removal exactly zero, a different numeric path from the pipe lines, which carry the real FDTD lateral residual (pilot bg x 0.4/3.6 vs 2.0: 2.2e-6, 2.0e-6 relative)
g4_background_line.cost: one more 161-trace run, about 9.5 min GPU (same as each pipe model)
g4_background_line.s1g_bg_role: S1G_bg (3 traces) and S1G_fs stay as time-zero references (surface reflection = bg - fs)
g4_background_line.applied: G4 applied (user decision 2026-11-11, spec_eval v1.9 section 12-4-3; G4 failure -> hold, rank 3)

models.role: background line (no pipe), 161 traces x = 0.4..3.6, for the G4 null test (spec_eval v1.9 section 12-4-3); export as line S1G/S1G_BGL
free-space reference (no soil), 1 trace at x = 2.0; bg - fs isolates the surface reflection

time_zero_candidates_ns_measured_pilot.notes: envelope (Hilbert) peaks with parabolic refinement, trace x = 2.0. surface_reflection_geom (offset path) = 3.5743 ns

known_extra_events: pipe-ground-surface multiple near 27-29 ns at the apex (apparent depth about 2 x 0.6 m), about 5-8 % of the primary apex peak (read from pilot_ascans.png), present in all pipe models

pipe-to-pipe multiples in the two-pipe models from about 20 ns at the midpoint (Fermat apex 21.60 ns for D060, pilot 21.62 ns), about 12 % of the midpoint primary peak; full list with mixed pipe-surface paths in expected_events

expected_events_meta.written: 2026-11-11, before any full-run output existed (pilot traces x=1.7/2.0/2.3 and geometry only)
expected_events_meta.axes: x_m = trace_x_m_first + i*dx with trace_x_m_first 0.40, dx 0.02 (Tx/Rx midpoint); t_ns = time_of_sample0_ns + k*dt with time_of_sample0_ns 0.0 (raw simulation time, two-way, no time-zero shift), i.e. the same axes as the M01-M20 export json
expected_events_meta.t_definition: expected envelope (Hilbert) peak = source peak sqrt(2)/f (2.8284 ns) + Fermat ray time + wavelet lag 0.036 ns (pilot primary)
expected_events_meta.x_definition: apex = trace position (0.02 m grid) of minimum ray time of that path
expected_events_meta.apparent_depth_m: v*(t_ns - 3.616)/2, v = c/3, zero = pilot surface-reflection peak (bg - fs)
expected_events_meta.apparent_depth_m_band_zero: v*(t_ns - 3.218)/2, zero = pilot single direct+surface band envelope peak (what an air_single_event zero would give)

kinds.primary: pipe crown reflection, the only truth

expected_events_meta.enumeration: all paths with <= 3 pipe scatterings and <= 2 surface bounces; reciprocal (reversed) paths are the same event; mirror-symmetric paths with identical curves are merged
expected_events_meta.not_listed: paths with >= 4 scatterings or >= 3 surface bounces (pilot amplitudes of the 3-scattering events are 0.5-5.5 % of the primary, higher orders are expected below ~1 %); hyperbola wings are not events
expected_events_meta.pilot_validation: 9 events measured on pilot traces agree with geometry within -0.24..+0.08 ns (largest: Tx-A-S-B-S-A at x 1.70 vs apex 1.72)
expected_events_meta.ambiguity: S1G_D100: M1 order 2 (x 1.5/2.5, 39.58 ns) and Tx-A-B-S-A / Tx-B-A-S-B (x 1.52/2.48, 40.45/40.43 ns) are within the attach window (dt 0.84-0.86 ns); both are non-primary, attach by nearest time
expected_events_meta.amplitude_caveat: 2D line-source amplitudes; relative amplitudes are qualitative for 3D
expected_events_meta.background_line: S1G_BGL has no scattering event: only the time-zero band (direct coupling + surface reflection merged, envelope peak 3.218 ns, surface-reflection component 3.616 ns, laterally invariant). Any QC-passing candidate at apparent depth 0.50-0.70 m fails G4; any candidate at all is unexplained (U)
